text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Strong, far too strong! Narita Brian! She 
refuses to let up on her speed!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaagh!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (...It's not reaching.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(It's completely different from the 
'Satsuki Sho.' Far more so than back 
then—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: More, I need even more...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Way too strong.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That strength of yours is practically 
arrogant, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "...If that's how it is. Then I won't—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I want to get stronger... It can't end 
here.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“—I want wings to surpass you, my idol, 
someday, and take flight toward the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe.”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent run by Narita Brian!! The 
Umamusume who conquered the Derby was none 
other than her!
Waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... *pant*... *gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Aah, geez!! Brian-chan, you're soooo 
amazing--!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
In the end, until I broke these legs of 
mine, I was never able to give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...I wanted to become someone who could 
chase after them with everything I have 
one day."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I stopped myself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: You were so strong, Brian-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And she doesn't take her natural talent 
for granted—she sincerely pursues speed 
and speed alone. She's completely 
flawless. It's almost unfair.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Still, I won't lose either!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure that in the remaining Kikuka 
Sho, Brian-chan will show us an incredibly 
powerful run."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep holding onto the desire to beat 
that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep wishing that someday, I'll be 
running out ahead of her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Though, Brian-chan might not even 
recognize me as a rival yet."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...I want to be like her, too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, I'd love for Brian-chan 
to become even stronger at the Kikuka 
Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'd rather they be completely unbeatable! 
Because that way—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Before someone else takes them down, I'll 
have my chance to defeat them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel looks ahead. Straight toward 
the ideal she yearns for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —She hesitates no longer.
